summary: Email marketing and audience management platform.
access_note: API keys generated in account settings; OAuth apps registered on the Registered Apps page.

evidence.quote: This page walks through implementing OAuth 2 so your application can access the Marketing API on behalf of other Mailchimp users.
Registering gives you the client_id and client_secret your server needs.
The Marketing API generally follows REST conventions, with some deviations.
This searches documentation, not your Mailchimp account.
